🔴 WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL — read before adding anything:
The hard rule is NO HARDCODED STATS IN REPORTS (feedback_no_hardcoded_stats). That rule is about
inventing numbers, or asserting a figure with no provenance. It is NOT a ban on citing published
research. The difference is entirely this file's structure: every value carries publisher, method,
sample size, URL and as_of. A report may cite these ONLY with attribution attached.
🔴 A stat with no `source_url` and `as_of` must NEVER be added here. If you cannot cite it, it does
not go in. And these are BENCHMARKS TO COMPARE AGAINST — never restate them as RGA's own results.
These figures are external context. RGA's own measured data lives in data/vertical-benchmarks/ and
